responsibility: Provides the GNU/Linux subtarget configuration for RISC-V at the preprocessor, driver, and linker-spec level. It defines Linux and libc-specific builtins, dynamic-linker paths for glibc and musl, icache flush symbol naming, link emulation suffixes by ABI, executable-stack handling, library search prefixes, and ABI-based multilib selection, separating Linux runtime conventions from the bare-metal ELF and FreeBSD headers.
